turns.user: I worked at a garment factory in Tiruppur. They haven't paid me Rs 42,000, my wages for September and October 2026. I want to file a claim with the labour authority. Please draft it.
turns.reply:
It is very difficult when you work hard and your wages are not paid. I am sorry you are going through this.

Under the **Code on Wages, 2019**, your employer is legally required to pay your wages on time [[COW2019:s17]]. If they fail to do so, you have the right to file a claim before the designated authority for the recovery of these wages [[COW2019:s45]]. The authority is responsible for determining the amount owed and may also order the employer to pay compensation for the delay [[COW2019:s45]].

I have drafted an application for you. You can download it below. Please make sure to fill in all the details marked in square brackets (e.g., [YOUR NAME]) before you print and sign it.

**Important things to remember:**
1. **Evidence:** Your case will be much stronger if you have proof. Please collect any documents you have, such as your appointment letter, payslips, bank statements, or even text messages/emails where you asked the employer for your salary.
2. **Where to file:** The law allows for claims to be filed before an authority appointed by the government [[COW2019:s45]], but as the specific local rules for filing this claim in your state are not in the library I can check, you will need to inquire locally about the exact office where this application should be submitted.
3. **Legal Help:** If you need further guidance or feel overwhelmed, you can call the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) helpline at **15100**. They provide free legal aid to eligible people [[NOTE:NALSA]].

I have saved the document for you: [Download Application for Unpaid Wages - Tiruppur](doc3).

**A few questions to help me support you better:**
* Do you have any documents (like payslips or an appointment letter) to prove your employment?
* Have you already spoken to the factory owner or the manager about this, and what did they say?

# Application for Recovery of Unpaid Wages

To,
The Labour Commissioner / Designated Authority,
Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu.

Subject: Application for recovery of unpaid wages.

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, [YOUR NAME], residing at [YOUR ADDRESS], was employed as a [YOUR DESIGNATION] at [NAME OF GARMENT FACTORY], located at [ADDRESS OF FACTORY].

I am filing this application to claim my unpaid wages for the months of September 2026 and October 2026. Despite my repeated requests, the employer has failed to pay my due wages of Rs 42,000. 

According to the Code on Wages, 2019, an employer is required to pay wages within the specified time limits [[COW2019:s17]]. As an employee, I have a right to file a claim before the designated authority for the recovery of these wages [[COW2019:s45]].

I request you to:
1. Direct the employer to pay my outstanding wages of Rs 42,000 immediately [[COW2019:s45]].
2. Order the employer to pay compensation as provided under the law for the delay and hardship caused [[COW2019:s45]].

I have attached copies of [LIST ANY DOCUMENTS YOU HAVE, E.G., APPOINTMENT LETTER, PAYSLIPS, ID CARD] as evidence of my employment and the dues.

Yours faithfully,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR PHONE NUMBER]
